page.title: Admin dashboard
page.intro: Monitor the queues, approve event signals and manage user roles.

modes.auto: Automatic (live if a key is set)

outbox.title: Event delivery queue (outbox)
outbox.empty: The event delivery queue is empty.
outbox.description: System events processed in the background (e.g. booking emails). Requeue permanently failed ones to try them again.

events.title: Event signal queue
events.textTooShort: The text must be at least {min} characters.
events.textHint: {min}–{max} characters. E.g. a news snippet: 'An international trade fair will be held in İzmir on 12–15 October.' A proposal does not affect prices until it is approved.

confirmReject.title: Reject the “{title}” proposal?
confirmReject.body: A rejected proposal does not affect prices and cannot be approved again from this list.

confirmRollback.title: Undo the approval of “{title}”?
confirmRollback.body: This event's effect on prices will be removed. A rolled-back event cannot be approved again here.

events.approveEffect: Approving immediately recalculates prices for nights around {start}–{end} in {city}.

doneRepriced.approve: {title}: proposal approved; {count, plural, =0 {no night prices changed} one {# night price recalculated} other {# night prices recalculated}}. You can undo it from the “Approved” filter.
doneRepriced.rollback: {title}: approval undone; {count, plural, =0 {no night prices changed} one {# night price recalculated} other {# night prices recalculated}}.

fraud.title: Fraud review queue

confirm.title: Mark booking {booking} as fraud?
confirm.body: The record leaves the queue and the user ({user}) is flagged with a fraud record. This decision cannot be undone here.

fraud.description: High-risk bookings. Review the reason codes and mark each record as legitimate or fraud.

rules.velocity: Many attempts in a short time
rules.velocity_user: Many attempts by the same user in a short time
rules.velocity_ip: Many attempts from the same IP address
rules.velocity_card: Many attempts with the same card
rules.new_account_high_amount: High amount on a new account
rules.bin_ip_country_mismatch: Card country does not match IP country

fraud.effectHint: “Mark as legitimate” removes the record from the queue; the booking stays as it is. “Mark as fraud” closes the record as confirmed fraud and flags the user with a fraud record; this decision cannot be undone here.

confirmRemove.title: Remove the review of “{property}”?
confirmRemove.body: The review is unpublished and the listing's rating is recalculated. This decision cannot be undone here.

experiments.title: A/B experiments
experiments.description: Conversion rates per variant for each experiment. If the variants' confidence intervals overlap, the difference is not yet significant.

roles.title: Change user role
roles.userIdHint: You cannot change your own role.
roles.updated: Role updated: {role}. All of the user's sessions were signed out; the new role applies when they sign in again.

confirm.title: Change the role of user {user}?
confirm.body: New role: {role}. All of the user's sessions will be signed out and they will need to sign in again.
confirm.adminBody: New role: {role}. This user will have access to all admin actions (payouts, claims, roles). All of the user's sessions will be signed out.

roles.newRoleHint: Changing the role signs the user out on all devices.
roles.updatedFor: Role of user {user} updated: {role}. Their sessions were signed out; the new role applies at their next sign-in.
roles.updatedFromTo: Role of user {user} changed: {from} → {to}. Their sessions were signed out; the new role applies at their next sign-in.

errors.notFound: No user found with this ID. Check the ID.
errors.forbidden: This role cannot be changed: you cannot change your own role, or you no longer have admin rights.

errors.NOT_FOUND: Record not found; another admin may have handled or deleted it.
errors.INVALID_STATE: The record’s status has changed; another admin may have handled it.
errors.CONFLICT: The record was changed at the same time. Refresh the list and try again.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: The last admin account cannot be demoted. Make another user an admin first.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this. If your admin rights changed, sign in again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: The submitted details are invalid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many actions in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.

staleRecord: Another admin may have already handled this record; the list was refreshed.

confirmResume.title: Resume payouts for {name} ({shortId})?
confirmResume.body: {count, plural, =0 {No payouts are pending.} one {# pending payout is released for sending right away.} other {# pending payouts are released for sending right away.}}

limitNote: Only {count} records are shown; more may be waiting in the queue. The next ones appear as you handle these.
